hard_rules: NEVER SHOW THE ANSWER IN THE STUDENT IMAGE; apply the shared student-figure answer-neutrality contract to every student-facing visual.
Notability/iPad-first student layout with generous response space; wasted space is acceptable.
Use every usable instructional source image in source order; default max displayed height 4in, preserve aspect ratio, allow only readability-driven exceptions up to 6in.
Do not squeeze images into thumbnail decorations and do not replace a good source/canonical figure with a crude redraw.
Production HTML links exactly ../../css/base.css then ../../css/notes.css; do not invent a third stylesheet solely for patch rules.
When deployed Notes CSS provides a specialized class/wrapper, use that exact shell rather than a generic h2/table/section substitute.
Teacher copy is browser-only: release fixed student workspace heights, allow natural vertical expansion, do not optimize for printed page breaks, and never allow overlap.

Teacher-only Notes support follows the established Algebra teacher-guide treatment: red, bold teacher text using ordinary paragraph/list elements inside a teacher-only wrapper; student-facing content keeps normal colors.
Every WTC, every Stop and Discuss, every Example, and every YTI has teacher-side Answer / Acceptable Reasoning plus Teacher Moves and Student Moves; add Listen For / Likely Misconception when useful.
Stop and Discuss teacher answers preserve the numbering of the 2–4 student prompts and appear after the student white-space workspace.

title.forbidden_substitution: Do not use h1.notes-title as the title card.

learning_target.rule: Exact I-can statements appear in the objectives list; do not create a giant separate generic I Can Statements heading.

vocabulary_preview.table_shape: three columns — Know for sure / Recognize / Don't know yet — and exactly one blank writing row
vocabulary_preview.rule: Vocabulary terms are listed outside the table in vocab-list; do not place one term per table row.

wtc.rule: Canonical Bank task remains exact; the annotation wrapper is presentation only.

skim.table_shape: two row-based rows only — What I noticed / What I wonder — with prompt cell left and writing cell right
forbidden: prediction row unless Framework explicitly requires it

close_reading_directions.rule: Blue annotation box exactly once; no standalone h2 Close Reading Directions.

i_can_reading.rule: Each exact I-can heads at least one major reading block while source concept order is preserved.

stop_and_discuss.rule: The colored stop-discuss box contains the title and 2–4 ordered-list prompts only. The white notes-ws workspace is a sibling outside the colored box.

formula_relationship.label: Formula / Relationship
formula_relationship.rule: Use the existing Math Notes reference visual language so the relationship is visually distinct from prose and from Close Reading directions.

example_yti.workspace_rule: Workspace is a sibling after notes-task-content, not nested inside it.

source_image_rule: Reference course-owned Physics Notes Image Toolkit assets in place from resources/Physics_Notes_Image_Toolkit/<toolkit_path> as declared by the Framework. Do not copy toolkit images into individual Notes section folders. Generated Notes-specific representations may use local section figures only when canonically required and no source/Bank/toolkit representation satisfies the instructional need.
